goal: Code migration review: a library or framework move that keeps behaviour and can be rolled back.
use: Code migration review: a library or framework move that keeps behaviour and can be rolled back. Use when a dependency, framework or API is being replaced.

steps.note: Map the old to new. List each old API call and its replacement.
Check behaviour. Flag calls whose defaults or errors changed.
Check coverage. Flag migrated code with no test.
Check rollback. The change must work with the old path still available.
Report. Each call with its status, the behaviour change and the risk.
